notes.note: Follow-up review of the capture service and fixture after the initial capture-delta review. The CDP double now returns a complete valid PNG. Capture metadata omits optional pixel width/height because the registry public screenshot API supplies only bytes and media type; viewport CSS dimensions are not image-dimension evidence. Clean pin, Task authority, blob/digest publication, region parsing and content headers are unchanged. Earlier fault and behavior receipts remain historical; final focused and fault runs are reported separately. No UI or real Chromium/provider qualification is claimed.
